problem:

M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

Question 1
?

Consider the augmented matrix M given by M=[1−21000]. Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

a
⟨−1+2y,y⟩,y∈(−∞,∞)
b
⟨1−2y,y⟩,y∈(−∞,∞)
c
⟨1,0⟩
d
⟨1,−2⟩
e
⟨1+2y,y⟩,y∈(−∞,∞)
